CNN's Jake Tapper had an exclusive interview with Lyndsey Fifield, a former girlfriend of Graham Platner's, the Democratic nominee in the US Senate election in Maine. Fifield alleged Platner physically abused her over a decade ago. This interview comes a day after Tapper interviewed a woman who accused Platner of rape, which he denies.
CNN reached out to the Platner campaign following the interview with Lyndsey Fifield. The campaign has denied Platner was violent towards women.
